details: The scrubber's `input` event calls `render()` synchronously on every mousemove without RAF coalescing, causing full D3 data-join DOM mutations at uncapped frequency. No `.interrupt()` is called when switching from timer-driven playback to scrubber or speed-change events, so in-flight unnamed enter/exit transitions can conflict with new ones (named 'move' transitions are self-interrupting, but enter/exit transitions are not).
